description: Asks which ranges are valid and what they match under the database (General) sort order: [C-A], [A-C], [a-C], [à-é], [a-æ] and [!A-C] against A, B, C, a, b, c, à, é, æ and - (Pat group p03), each pattern its own LIKE projection. Fixture r-expr-1-main2 is opened read-only through DAO.DBEngine.120; engine version and loaded modules are recorded; each recordset reads Name, Type and Value of every field.
retentionNote: Designed r-expr-1 probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
